pull_request.title: Documentation: render sector gaps from current DD4hep models
pull_request.head: codex/siw-allegro-sector-gap-drawing
pull_request.body:
Render the requested Si–W full sector plus neighbouring half-sectors and the same LAr angular window directly from **our current DD4hep placed geometry**, at z=0 with identical XY axes and zoom scales. Preserve native materials, supports, services and sensitive masks. The Si–W seam/rails/setbacks form an aligned inactive corridor; the corresponding LAr ray traverses inclined active gaps. LAr dashed guides are comparison markers, not module boundaries.

Model source: `f3ece1d6a6816c8172dfa841d63e5424730e8228`. This uses the maintained Si–W model rather than substituting the archival staggered sample. Includes SVG/PNG, compact hashed provenance, a pinned two-checkout reproduction recipe and native extraction/annotation tools. SVG embeds native raster geometry with vector labels.

![Current DD4hep sector comparison](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/5f99e2600d2fe9d02d3080d64ab8697c79c21cab/docs/design/figures/sector-gap-native/siw-allegro-sector-gap.png?raw=true)

[SVG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/siw-allegro-sector-gap-drawing/docs/design/figures/sector-gap-native/siw-allegro-sector-gap.svg) · [Recipe and limits](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/siw-allegro-sector-gap-drawing/docs/validation/sector-gap-native/README.md)

Validation: fresh current-source compact exports and native factories loaded successfully under DD4hep 1.38 / ROOT 6.40.04; all four native rasters repeated byte-identically; analytic thin-film pixel-area/chord fixture passed; exact-candidate PhysVal review found no material scientific or visual issues. Project, software inventory, session, interaction and token validation pass locally, including the observed-token preview build. Selected closed-turn request/response evidence and PR metadata are synchronized.

**Limits:** geometry illustration only; sensitive path segments are not layer counts, shower efficiencies or energy-resolution measurements. No geometry change, transport or engineering acceptance. Draft for review.

Tracking: TASK-PUB-ECAL-LAYOUT-REVIEW; DES-030/031/032. Known closed-turn usage: 33 requests / 10,370,178 tokens in the sole task journal; current active parent turn excluded.

events.text:
Fresh maintained Si–W `--real-wedges` and LAr `--real-periods`/services exports
use the exact model source above. Fresh factory libraries load those compacts
into DD4hep; ROOT navigation supplies material pixels and native
`dd4hep.Volume.isSensitive` supplies active masks. LAr material alone is not
sensitive. All inclined periods participate before final angular clipping,
including periods originating outside the displayed window.

Current nODD LAr retains its 0.2 mm total steel, 1.8 mm Pb, 1.2 mm electrode,
50.18° inclination, bath, cryostat and services. No older official-XML steel
override is applied. Current Si–W is the maintained model, not the archival
PR136/137 staggered-sample geometry. Morange PoS(EPS-HEP2025)510 §2/Fig.1 and
pinned k4geo records explain the design precedent; native geometry determines
this drawing. No published performance or engineering qualification transfers.

The IP ray at φ78.75° has 0 sensitive Si path segments versus 84 LAr segments;
±0.001 rad gives 0/0 and 95/95 respectively. Counts include volume segmentation:
they are not layers, shower efficiencies or resolution. LAr ±11.25° guides
are comparison markers, not physical module boundaries. Only z=0 is shown.
No transport, geometry modification or engineering qualification is claimed.

SVG has vector annotations and embedded native raster geometry, explicitly
labelled. Overview sampling integrates exact X boundaries with eight Y subrows;
the 160×112 mm zooms use two subrows. This preserves thin films better than
centre-point sampling; finite raster resolution remains.

events.text:
The two current models use **different detector envelopes**. The drawing preserves those actual dimensions.

| Boundary | Si–W¹ | LAr |
|---|---:|---:|
| Sampling front | 1700 mm | 2172.8 mm |
| Sampling back | 2223.2 mm | 2578.3 mm |
| Outer cover / cryostat | 2233.2 mm | 2830 mm |

¹ Si–W values are polygon **apothems**, measured at the sector centre.

The LAr prototype deliberately retained the ALLEGRO reference’s sampling radii, plane count and inclination. Its cryostat starts at **2100 mm**, with **72.8 mm** of walls, vacuum and bath before sampling, and **251.7 mm** behind sampling for bath/services and vessel walls. See [DES-032]([redacted]

So this compares the **current layouts and their gap topology**; their radial envelopes were never matched. The larger LAr radius is a retained prototype choice, rather than something established as necessary by this study.

events.text:
**SECTOR-GAP-PHYSVAL-SOURCE**, reviewed **f3ece1d6a6816c8172dfa841d63e5424730e8228**. Source contribution only; candidate drawing not yet reviewed.

Use the current nODD DD4hep exports as drawing authority:

- **SiW:** show the projective inactive corridor faithfully. It includes the 1 mm half-seams, passive 20 mm side rails, 40 mm board-edge allocation and incomplete sensor fill. It is not simply a 2 mm air crack. Internal board staggering does not remove retained carrier boundaries.
- **Our ALLEGRO-style model:** retain its **0.2 mm total steel**, actual sensitive LAr gaps, passive bath volumes, cryostat and services. A continuous LAr material bath is not a uniformly sensitive shell.
- Mark ±11.25° as **comparison guides**, not physical ALLEGRO sector boundaries. Include inclined solids originating outside the displayed angular window when they cross into it; filtering by origins would create artificial edge gaps.
- State the XY slice’s **z coordinate**. Supports/services visible in another slice may be absent here.

The primary ALLEGRO paper describes inclined absorbers with active noble liquid between absorber and electrode, avoiding the analogous ideal projective φ crack. That supports the topology explanation, not a blanket “gaps cause no problem” or uniform-response claim. [Morange, §2/Fig. 1]([external URL redacted; see source journal]).

Suggested labels:

- “Projective inactive corridor: seam, passive rails and sensor setback”
- “Sensitive LAr gaps between inclined absorber/electrode periods”
- “Comparison guide—not a module boundary”
- “Geometry illustration; energy-response uniformity not established”

Actual checks: verified all five pinned hashes; inspected DES031/032 and geometry construction; checked the public proceeding and [pinned official XML](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/blob/e1ba7bc3e0d7291ebe3f6a02abfa784f879e36cb/FCCee/ALLEGRO/compact/ALLEGRO_o1_v03/ECalBarrel_thetamodulemerged.xml), distinguishing its 0.1 mm steel proxy from nODD. No writes, native runtime or publication. Awaiting exact exported-candidate review.
